overview: Elemental Convergence is the Twilight Sea’s planar anomaly zone, where unstable elemental nodes collide and reshape the region.
history: The Convergence formed when elemental currents beneath the Sea destabilized.
Combine researchers attempted to map the nodes but failed due to volatility.
Stormbreaker Isles formed from repeated elemental eruptions.
Siren Courts avoid the region except during calm cycles.
Elemental manifestations began appearing after planar instability increased across Luclin.
hooks: A new elemental node forms, altering the region’s geography.
Fire and water nodes collide, creating a steam storm.
Air nodes destabilize, lifting parts of the sea floor.
Arcane resonance pulses attract Combine researchers.
